from common import *
import re

if __name__=='__main__':
    save_source(__file__)
    while not (TMP/'stop-monitor').exists():
        progress=read(PROGRESS);native=read(STATE)
        running=[j for j in progress['jobs'] if j['status']=='running'];done=sum(j['status']=='succeeded' for j in progress['jobs'])
        sample={'at':time.time(),'status':progress['status'],'stage':progress.get('pipeline_stage'),'completed_fits':done,'started_fits':len(progress['jobs']),'remaining_hours':(native['deadline']-time.time())/3600,'running_jobs':running}
        if running:
            job=running[0];log=TMP/f'{job["job_id"]}.log'
            rounds=re.findall(r'^\[(\d+)\]\s+valid.*$',log.read_text() if log.exists() else '',re.M)
            sample['latest_logged_round']=int(rounds[-1]) if rounds else None
            ps=subprocess.run(['ps','-p',str(job['pid']),'-o','pid=,ppid=,rss=,%cpu=,etime='],capture_output=True,text=True);sample['process_sample']=ps.stdout.strip()
            message=f'{done}/35 fits complete; {job["job_id"]} {job.get("phase")}; latest logged round={sample["latest_logged_round"]}'
        else:message=f'{done}/35 fits complete; stage={progress.get("pipeline_stage",progress["status"])}'
        sample['system_swap']=subprocess.run(['sysctl','-n','vm.swapusage'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
        with (TMP/'resource-samples.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(sample,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
        print(message+f'; remaining budget={sample["remaining_hours"]:.2f}h',flush=True)
        failures=sorted((BASE/'docs').glob('pipeline-failure-*.json'))
        if failures:
            print('PIPELINE STOPPED',read(failures[-1])['error'],flush=True);break
        if progress['status'] in ['budget_stop_pending_closeout','evaluation_complete_awaiting_review']:
            print('READY FOR REVIEW/CLOSEOUT',progress['status'],flush=True);break
        time.sleep(50)
